manifest.name: lifecycle_demo
manifest.description: Lifecycle hooks, background media and self-suspension

commands.name: demo_pause
commands.description: Ask the runtime to pause this module

source: fn installed(event, config) { #{state: #{starts: 0, label: config.label}} } fn ready(event, config) { let count = if state == () { 0 } else { state.starts }; #{state: #{starts: count + 1, label: config.label}} } fn unload(event, config) { #{state: #{starts: state.starts, label: state.label, last_unload: event.data.reason}} } fn changed(event, config) { #{state: #{starts: state.starts, label: config.label}} } fn status(args, config) { #{text: json_stringify(state)} } fn pause(args, config) { #{suspend: "Paused by demo command", text: "Reload this package with .lm to resume"} } fn tick(event, config) { #{media: #{kind: "photo", source: #{type: "url", url: "https://example.com/photo.jpg"}}, text: config.label} }
